brand.name: Mitsubishi Electric
brand.notes: Mitsubishi Electric AC for PK market (Mitsubishi Electric Cooling & Heating — Mr. Slim, split inverter, City Multi VRF; PEL distributes in PK). CRITICAL SCOPE: Mitsubishi Electric ≠ Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) ≠ Mitsubishi Motors — MHI tables (E75 etc.) never imported. Primary sources: ME Malaysia official troubleshooting (A-control, high) + MrSlimErrorCode-V2/CityMultiErrorCode_V4 PDFs (ME SG, high) + ME UK/IE Fault Code Check List (orionair mirror) + K-control service manual + arma.org.au PDF. Control-type scoped: A-control vs K-control vs City Multi PUCY vs PUMY kept in separate series files — same digits across generations never merged. No official ME PK site (mitsubishielectric.com/pk 404) — ME regional/global official tables apply to PK-sold families. Quarantines: MHI, Mitsubishi Motors, Hitachi/Toshiba lookalike tables, non-AC.
